notes.title: Bouncemasters Demo is out NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Penguin-Launching Season has officially begun![/h1]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33026674/575e8f85672a5bae5138e522cb0d1dbac59f113f.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3774120/Bouncemasters_Demo/

🔥 In this funny arcade game you launch a penguin from the North Pole, bouncing through outrageous obstacles in pursuit of love - or simply to fail in the most hilarious ways!

❤️ Wishlist the full game BounceMasters - because Your Wishlist Bounce[b]MATTERS![/b]

notes.title: Upcoming Release - Bouncemasters: Fly Pengu, Fly!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33026674/4bfc3b61bf987cdf7a2bad634ca50cc242bb7d1b.png[/img]
🔥 We have just announced Bouncemasters - fast, silly, and full of absurd physics-based fun game! All you do is launch a penguin with a bat of your choice - and try to fly as far as you can! And only one advice for you. Stay away from moose butt.

That is probably enough for the intro part - you still have something to do!

[h1]🎯 To Do List[/h1]
[b]✅ Watch the Trailer[/b]
https://youtu.be/l9cY8CrJx4M 
[b]✅ Wishlist the game[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3697340/Bouncemasters_Fly_Pengu_Fly/?utm_source=steam&utm_campaign=announcement
[b]⌛ Wait for Bouncemasters DEMO - Coming to Next Fest![/b]

notes.title: Where Alchemy meets Idle? Announcing new Alchemy adventure - Idle Craft!
notes.content:
[h3]🏝️ Want a relaxing crafting experience that fits your busy schedule?
Happy to announce, that [b]Idle Craft[/b] will be released on Steam in 2025![/h3]

🧪 Idle Craft combines the satisfying merging mechanics you love with charming hand-drawn art. And yeah, we have got you covered - your world grows even while you are away!

Wishlist today and prepare for an enchanting alchemic journey!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/798470/Idle_Craft/

[b]Welcome to the newly updated Doodle God Blitz!
Dear players, after your numerous requests and offers we`ve added the following features: [/b]

- New activity reward system: for every day you play Doodle God Blitz, you`re getting rewarded with Coins you can spend on hints and additional content (DLC). You can earn Coins by participating in a tournament as well.

- New Daily Bonus system: collect your daily reward of hints and coins

- New "Survivor" DLC is available. Your objective is to create something to escape from the island in the middle of the ocean.

- Controller support - now it`s more comfortable to play.

Enjoy and thank you for your support!

notes.title: Revelations of New Episodes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29002788/001004bcdf2f65c43b254887efb36633e00e3475.png[/img]
[b]Behold, Doodlers! Turn your ears, fix your eyes, and hold your breath: great news coming right from the Big Boss![/b]

[h1][b]AWESOME NEW CONTENT[/b][/h1]

For those of you blessed with a quick mind and a strong desire to experiment, there's a [b]NEW EPISODE RELEASED[/b] plus a [b]DLC coming[/b]! The new episode is already available, and if you just can't live without doodling, you can purchase a DLC and go for it ;) 

[h1][b]MORE NEW CONTENT ON THE WAY![/b][/h1]

Besides, Doodle God is going to spoil you with [b]UPDATES EVERY 2 WEEKS[/b] now. It took 7 days to create the world, and look what mess it's in now :) So this time we're going to make this Universe right!

Enjoy the update and feel free to share your admiring reviews with everyone ;)
